title: Is gpt-6-luna reliable enough for classification and inventory task families?
summary: Luna is callable through the router (selection and adapter invocation verified; quota-blocked during bootstrap). Answer by running the EVC development set through `orchestrate delegate --provider codex` after the usage reset and comparing accuracy and cost per success with CAP-be9d7454fc and CAP-793f8cdfde. ANSWER (EVR-0005, 2026-09-29, n=1 per route, pinned base f8f4453f): no. gpt-6-luna at effort low scored 0.60 accuracy (12/20) vs Sonnet 0.75 and Haiku 0.65; 166s and 544k input tokens; cost not reported by the Codex subscription. It does not qualify for research_implementation_classification. Inventory-style families remain untested for Luna.
